name: dax_year_to_date_by_month
expect_sql:
SELECT u.k1 AS year,
       u.k2 AS month,
       (MAX(u.s1)) AS sales_ytd,
       (MAX(u.s2)) AS sales_fytd
FROM (
SELECT c.k1 AS k1,
       c.k2 AS k2,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s1,
       NULL AS s2
FROM   (
  SELECT d.year AS k1, d.month AS k2, MIN(d.date_key) AS lo, MAX(d.date_key) AS hi
  FROM   retail.dim_date d
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month
) c
JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.date_key BETWEEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('year', c.hi) AS DATE) AND c.hi
JOIN retail.fct_sales t ON t.order_date = s.date_key
GROUP BY c.k1, c.k2
  UNION ALL
SELECT c.k1 AS k1,
       c.k2 AS k2,
       NULL AS s1,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s2
FROM   (
  SELECT d.year AS k1, d.month AS k2, MIN(d.date_key) AS lo, MAX(d.date_key) AS hi
  FROM   retail.dim_date d
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month
) c
JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.date_key BETWEEN CAST(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('year', CAST(c.hi + INTERVAL (6) MONTH AS DATE)) AS DATE) + INTERVAL (-6) MONTH AS DATE) AND c.hi
JOIN retail.fct_sales t ON t.order_date = s.date_key
GROUP BY c.k1, c.k2
) u
GROUP BY u.k1, u.k2
